XI, end, 48ᵇ</cite> <he>על ידי דמניהון צ׳ וכ׳</he> because they (the mourners) wear unwashed garments, they do not hesitate to handle lamps themselves, opp. <he>נקיין</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 11:5:12">ib.</cite> <he>צוֹאִין</he> (h. form).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:4:7">Y. Taan. I, 64ᶜ</cite> top <he>לבשה מאנין צאין</he> she wore soiled garments; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:4:7">ib.</cite> <he>צָאיִין</he>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5">Lev. R. s. 5</cite>, end <he>מניה צואין</he> (some ed. <he>צואן</he>, corr. acc.) his garments unwashed; a. e.
